notes: Audit #2 Batch 2 «هم‌روندی پوش و pull» (v1.11.69) — the second of the 5 approved batches of the v1.11.67 full audit (88/100, 0 Critical, 0 High). (1) M4 — push-run lock (option (a) of the report, dedicated lock): a new PUSH_RUN_LOCK (plain Lock, srv/common.py) serializes whole sync runs again. PR6 (1.11.65) dropped @_with_sync_lock from push_to_google, which left the creates/updates/done phase with NO lock at all — two concurrent pushes fully overlapped (audit probe: 2.05s wall vs ~4s serial) and could both create a Google event for the same box, orphaning the first. push_to_google now holds PUSH_RUN_LOCK for the whole run and releases it only around each _push_deletions chunk call (PR6 behaviour kept intact: deletions still in chunks of 25, pull/push-one slip in between chunks); run_calendar_sync and box_api_push_one take PUSH_RUN_LOCK outside @_with_sync_lock, so the acquisition order is always PUSH_RUN_LOCK -> SYNC_LOCK -> STATE_LOCK and neither plain Lock is ever re-entered. Live probe after the fix: two concurrent pushes with a slow provider take 4.02s wall (serial), max 1 run inside phase B, both ok, and only ONE Google event is created for the same box. (2) C4 — the stale whole-run-serialization comments are corrected: server.py push_to_google docstring, box_api_push_one docstring + its _PUSH_IN_FLIGHT comment + phase-B header, run_calendar_sync docstring, and the srv/common.py SYNC_LOCK/_PUSH_IN_FLIGHT comments now name PUSH_RUN_LOCK as the run mutex and SYNC_LOCK as the short critical-section lock only. (3) L18 — the bulk-delete push now goes through fetchWithTimeout (120s SYNC_TIMEOUT_MS) like the other manual push sites; a hung push used to stall the bulk-delete result line forever. (4) L16 — first-pull index: merge_calendar_events builds one (date, start, title) -> box index before the event loop and uses it for both the deleted check and the exact-match lookup, with identical semantics (deleted boxes excluded at build, the live uid_set filter applied at lookup, ambiguous triple still links nothing; when `deleted` is empty the deleted check is skipped entirely). The helpers _find_exact_matches/_find_deleted_match stay as the tested single-call API. Live probe: dry-run first pull (318 events, empty uid_map) median 29.3ms -> 8.4ms (audit baseline 26.0ms). Nothing deferred. i18n 1439/1439 (no new keys).
